mapper.sql: h.id, h.title, h.description, h.price, h.area, h.rooms, h.bedroom_count, h.living_room_count, h.bathroom_count, h.kitchen_count, h.house_type, h.region_id, h.address_detail, h.image, h.landlord_id, h.status, h.click_count, h.is_active AS active, h.create_time, h.update_time, r.name AS region_name, d.name AS district_name, c.name AS city_name, u.id AS landlord_user_id, u.username AS landlord_username, p.phone AS landlord_phone, p.avatar AS landlord_avatar

FROM house h LEFT JOIN area r ON r.id = h.region_id LEFT JOIN area d ON d.id = r.parent_id LEFT JOIN area c ON c.id = d.parent_id JOIN user_profile p ON p.id = h.landlord_id JOIN auth_user u ON u.id = p.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(h.update_time) FROM house h WHERE h.status = 'approved' AND h.is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house (title, description, price, area, rooms, bedroom_count, living_room_count, bathroom_count, kitchen_count, house_type, region_id, address_detail, image, landlord_id, status, click_count, is_active, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{area}, #{rooms}, #{bedroomCount}, #{livingRoomCount}, #{bathroomCount}, #{kitchenCount}, #{houseType}, #{regionId}, #{addressDetail}, #{image}, #{landlordId}, #{status}, #{clickCount}, #{active}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE house SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, area = #{area}, rooms = #{rooms}, bedroom_count = #{bedroomCount}, living_room_count = #{livingRoomCount}, bathroom_count = #{bathroomCount}, kitchen_count = #{kitchenCount}, house_type = #{houseType}, region_id = #{regionId}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, image = #{image}, status = #{status}, is_active = #{active}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE house SET status = #{status}, is_active = #{active}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
